per_claim_reviews.assessment: Exact functor of points, fixed field, rank-zero case, polynomial inverse and closed faithful F-matrix representation are checked. No determinant condition or source tensor algebra is changed.
E-tensor splitting and the J-transpose relation give geometric GL_n. The independent Jordan/transposed-Jordan trace argument rules out a nontrivial normal unipotent subgroup in characteristic zero.

All geometric characters are determinant powers by diagonal/elementary generators; the CM descent involution negates the exponent. This proves the exact F-rational character condition, without conflating it with continuous characters.

Finite-free module topology matches matrix coordinates; the inverse formula identifies both source matrix and inverse topology. Actual integral restricted-product conditions agree outside finitely many places. Rational subgroup, product decomposition, countability, discreteness and closedness are proved.

Borel Lemma5.5 and Theorem5.6(i) were independently reopened in the primary text and matched to the exact F-group, identity component, rational characters, adeles and principal subgroup. Inversion correctly changes the quotient orientation and preserves finite invariant measure.
Countable right-translated slices are each injective on left rational orbits; least-index selection gives an exact Borel section, not just an almost-everywhere chosen quotient representative.

Orbit-sum lifting gives locally finite nonzero right Haar measure; compact intersection counting and Haar uniqueness identify its scale with any supplied measure. Exact-domain partition plus Tonelli proves equality for every original AE fundamental domain, including null-measurable ones.

Full FiniteVolume₂ universal data/hypotheses are retained, including arbitrary Haar/FD. Original CM data and Gram nondegeneracy are explicitly matched. All four FinPair fields and positive volume are supplied on the literal target.

Borel5.1 is separately matched; inversion and real-factor removal give the finite cover for standard K0. Compact finite-index refinement gives every original open finite K without requiring K compact or changing the left rational matrices.

The rational restriction-of-scalars representation identifies the actual integral lattice subgroup. Compact-open intersections give arithmetic Gamma_s; discreteness uses compact finite slices. Actual real factors and compact scalar-circle center are checked, as are the orientation of phi_s and the full adelic factorization.

Universal target finite pairs can be chosen once per i before t,x and all functions. Literal nuQ and downstream regular/representative measures are unchanged. The separate initial seed bound and common geometric data are not supplied by this chapter.
